s=s.replace("    signs = np.where(z > 0.5, -1.0, 1.0)\n","    # z_i = 0 -> active side is u_i.x > ..., so w_i ∝ +u_i; else w_i ∝ -u_i\n    signs = np.where(z > 0.5, -1.0, 1.0)\n")
